acceptanceCriteria: A regression shows run --role implementer does not pick an answered WAITING attempt of another stage.
body: Observed on branch claude/v1-0475-multi-repo (head e62e5bdb, base origin/main d524530f), Corvint 1.0.0-rc.1 build 163, Go 1.27.1, darwin/arm64, by the issue 354 lane. Found by the issue 354 lane; not reproduced as a retained regression. The CLI run command with --role implementer selects answered WAITING attempts regardless of the attempt stage, so an implementer run can resume a review or integrate stage attempt. Expected: the role filter applies to the stage of the WAITING attempt.

completion.reason: Delivered and merged to main in beamfall/corvint#694 (merge ba5c0df3, batch K1). Evidence: sha256 of docs/build-log/ lane entry and 2026-10-08-batch-k1-integration.md at ba5c0df3; focused tests, independent review and sealed CEM recorded there.

title: run --role implementer reselects answered WAITING attempts of any stage
